name: Jellyfin Concert Radar
description: Aggregates upcoming concerts for the artists in your Jellyfin music library from multiple sources (Ticketmaster, Bandsintown, EdmTrain, Songkick, Dice.fm, Resident Advisor), normalizes them, and surfaces them in admin and user-accessible views.
overview: Upcoming concerts for artists in your music library.

versions.changelog: Initial release. See CHANGELOG.md for the full list of features.
